blocks.heading: Beginner Questions
blocks.summary: 6 short questions and answers on the login and the account.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 6 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) which details registration asks for (e-mail, password, legal name, date of birth, residential address); (2) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (3) what to do after a forgotten password (request a reset link with the registered e-mail); (4) whether a player may hold more than one account (no: one personal account per player); (5) when the welcome bonus can be claimed (after registration, on the first qualifying deposit of at least €50); (6) where to turn when the login still fails (customer support: live chat 24/7 or e-mail; do not print the e-mail address). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
